recommendation_summary: Set up a single Healthchecks.io heartbeat check that the cron wrapper pings on success or failure, so an email alert goes out when nightly-sync fails or never runs; also fix the expired token, keep the existing summary email, and test both failure modes.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want an alert when `nightly-sync` fails or never runs, without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging, Docker, and a Synology deployment for this one job.
labels.Bottleneck: The job sends its own notification, so an early crash silences it.
labels.Checked myself: Only your supplied facts: four startup failures, no email, and no independent alert.

note: The reply recommends one hosted heartbeat alert and turns down the user's Synology, Docker and central-log idea; fixing the token and keeping the existing email don't add a second monitor.
